en.one: Runs 39 animal hospitals in Japan. Passed the quality walls, narrow moat; last year's profit includes a one-off gain and the forecast is 7% growth.
en.business: WOLVES HAND runs hospitals for pets in Japan; it earns its money from the examination and treatment fees paid by pet owners. At the end of June 2026 it had 39 sites: 12 centre hospitals and 27 satellite hospitals (Kansai 15, Kanto 14, Kyushu and Okinawa 9, Hokkaido 1). In the year to June 2026 sales were 6.16 billion yen and operating profit 1.13 billion yen; about 84% of sales came from the hospitals. The rest is veterinary clinic software, veterinary education, medical devices and hygiene devices. The fiscal year ends in June.
en.moat_text: The moat is narrow. The advantage comes from advanced equipment at the centre hospitals (CT, MRI, radiotherapy) and from the network: satellite hospitals handle everyday care and send difficult cases to the group's own centre. That equipment is expensive for a single clinic to install. The figures support this: the operating margin is 18.3% (16.6% a year earlier) and the number of cases in the year was 415,891 (395,059 a year earlier). Real return on equity ranged from 22.0% to 36.0% over the last four fiscal years. The weak side: the sector is very fragmented and a clinic is easy to open; the advantage is local and depends on the veterinarians (115 on average in the year). The record is short: the company listed in 2024, and in fiscal 2020 it wrote off 2.05 billion yen of acquisition-related value. Goodwill is 1.76 billion yen, 26.0% of assets.
en.mgmt: The company is run by its founder and chief executive, Masashi Kitai. On 30 June 2026 he owned 43.36% of the shares and J-STAR funds 37.7%. In the secondary offering announced on 2 September 2026, J-STAR funds sold 2,453,600 shares and Kitai 200,000; the over-allotment was 398,000 shares, of which 200,800 were taken up. The largest J-STAR fund went from 15.55% to almost nothing; Kitai was left with 3,080,300 shares. The offer price could not be read. The company has never paid a dividend; for the year to June 2027 it plans its first, 26 yen per share (about 20% of profit). Profit has gone to buying hospitals and repaying debt. There are small flaws: last year's purchases went outside the main business (a laser device maker, a photocatalyst business, a chitin nanofibre business); buildings and parking are leased from a company wholly owned by the chief executive (24.2 million yen a year); and a share buyback in December 2020 breached capital-maintenance rules. Financial debt is 1.97 billion yen and cash 0.81 billion yen (net debt/EBITDA 0.79). Second reading (20 November 2026): In the year to June 2026 share-based pay cost 14.9 million yen, 1.6% of net profit. On 30 September 2026 restricted shares went to 57 employees and to 13 directors and employees of subsidiaries: 285,500 treasury shares at 2,042 yen each, about 583 million yen; the restriction runs until 29 September 2033. Outstanding options cover 436,400 shares (exercise price 500-1,085 yen). To soften the effect of the offering the company decided to buy back up to 100,000 shares and 300 million yen between 13 October 2026 and 12 October 2027, on the market. Last year's purchases: See for 550 million yen (goodwill 283 million), Asuka Medical for 55 million yen and the Kaltech business for 140 million yen. In July-August 2026 it bought Meditrix (clinical research services, 55.3 million yen) and North One, which runs one animal hospital. Goodwill was 2.14 billion yen on 30 September 2026, 47.5% of net assets.
en.latest: 11 November 2026: results for the July-September 2026 quarter (the first quarter of the new fiscal year) were announced. Sales rose 24.2% to 1.70 billion yen, operating profit rose 16.5% to 279 million yen, net profit rose 15.8% to 192 million yen and earnings per share were 25.30 yen (22.13 yen a year earlier). The operating margin fell to 16.4% (17.5% a year earlier). The figures were read from the company's results filing; the quarter has no extraordinary income or loss. The company left its forecast for the year to June 2027 unchanged: sales 7.54 billion yen (+22.4%), operating profit 1.57 billion yen (+39.3%), net profit 1.01 billion yen (+7.0%), earnings per share 132.90 yen, dividend 26 yen. Net assets were 4.51 billion yen on 30 September 2026 (3.72 billion yen at the end of June). Of the rise, 595 million yen came not from profit but from treasury shares given to employees as restricted stock. Two companies were consolidated in the quarter (North One, Meditrix); goodwill rose by 385 million yen to 2.14 billion yen. The profit of the last 12 months still contains the extraordinary income of the year to June 2026: a 227 million yen negative goodwill gain (the photocatalyst business taken over in January 2026); an impairment of 83 million yen was booked in the same period. On 2 September 2026 a secondary share offering, a share buyback decision and a restricted share award were announced.
risks: The profit of the last 12 months was enlarged by a one-off gain: the 227 million yen negative goodwill gain is close to a quarter of the net profit of the last 12 months (about 965 million yen). The company expects net profit to rise only 7.0% in the new year; if the growth assumed in the price calculation is higher than that, the margin of safety weakens.

Growth rests on acquisitions, and the company is moving outside its main business (laser devices, photocatalyst, chitin nanofibre, clinical research services). In the July-September 2026 quarter sales rose 24.2% while operating profit rose 16.5%; the margin fell from 17.5% to 16.4%. The medical hygiene devices arm lost 3.8 million yen in the quarter. If these businesses do not earn a profit, new impairments may follow; goodwill was 2.14 billion yen on 30 September 2026, 47.5% of net assets.
Veterinarians are hard to find; competition for new graduates is intense. Losing veterinarians or paying them more cuts hospital profit directly.
The record is short: the company listed in 2024 and only four of the five years of return-on-equity history exist. The high return comes partly from a small equity base.

The company depends on its founder, and there are related-party leases with him (24.2 million yen a year). With the share offering in September 2026 the J-STAR funds largely left; the founder also sold 200,000 shares.

Share-based pay is growing: the restricted shares awarded on 30 September 2026 are worth about 583 million yen. Spread evenly over seven years that is about 83 million yen a year, 8.6% of the net profit of the last 12 months (966 million yen) (our own calculation; the company has not disclosed the yearly charge). The awarded shares and outstanding options equal about 9% of the share count.

The bank loans carry covenants: no loss two years running, and cash flow not below a set amount (350 or 400 million yen, depending on the loan). The parent pays 221 million yen a year in rent for leased hospitals; the balance sheet carries 142 million yen of restoration obligations.

basis.tr: Hesap son 12 ayın kârına dayanır. Bu kârın içindeki tek seferlik kazançlar: Negatif şerefiye kazancı: Ocak 2026'da bağlı ortaklık Kaltech'in devraldığı fotokatalizör işinde ödenen bedel, alınan net varlıkların değerinden düşük kaldı (olağan dışı gelir, 227,5 milyon yen vergi öncesi; menkul kıymet raporunun vergi mutabakatına göre bu kazanç vergilenmedi, tutarın tamamı alındı): son 12 ay kârının %23,6 kadarı; Kademeli edinim kazancı: iştirak Asuka Medical'in tamamı alınırken eski payın yeniden değerlenmesi (olağan dışı gelir, 12,9 milyon yen vergi öncesi): son 12 ay kârının %1,0 kadarı; Duran varlık satış kazancı (olağan dışı gelir, Ekim 2025-Haziran 2026 için 8,3 milyon yen vergi öncesi; yılın 11,0 milyon yeninden Temmuz-Eylül 2025'in 2,7 milyon yeni çıkarıldı): son 12 ay kârının %0,6 kadarı. Aynı dönemin tek seferlik giderleri: Değer düşüklüğü zararı (olağan dışı gider, 83,4 milyon yen vergi öncesi): %6,3. Net etki %18,9; kazanç bu kadar indirildi. Şirketin Haziran 2027 mali yılı için hisse başına kâr beklentisi 132,90 JPY; son 12 ayda 128,05 JPY. Beklenti daha düşük değil. Son 12 ayın kârı 0,81 ile çarpılarak kullanıldı.
basis.en: The calculation rests on the profit of the last 12 months. One-off gains inside that profit: Negative goodwill gain: in the photocatalyst business taken over by the subsidiary Kaltech in January 2026 the price paid was below the value of the net assets acquired (extraordinary income, 227.5 million yen pre-tax; the tax reconciliation in the securities report shows this gain was not taxed, so the full amount is counted): 23.6% of last-12-month profit; Gain on step acquisition: revaluation of the earlier stake when the affiliate Asuka Medical became wholly owned (extraordinary income, 12.9 million yen pre-tax): 1.0% of last-12-month profit; Gain on sale of fixed assets (extraordinary income, 8.3 million yen pre-tax for October 2025-June 2026; the year's 11.0 million yen less 2.7 million yen of July-September 2025): 0.6% of last-12-month profit. One-off charges in the same period: Impairment loss (extraordinary loss, 83.4 million yen pre-tax): 6.3%. The net effect is 18.9%; earnings were lowered by that much. The company's earnings-per-share outlook for fiscal year to June 2027 is 132.90 JPY; the last 12 months were 128.05 JPY. The outlook is not lower. Last-12-month profit was used multiplied by 0.81.

basis.tr: Formül yılda %15,6 büyüme veriyordu. En güncel veriler (hisse başına kâr, yıllık değişim): Temmuz-Eylül 2026 çeyreği (yeni mali yılın ilk üç ayı) %14,3; Temmuz-Eylül 2026 çeyreği %14,3; Haziran 2027 yılı için şirket tahmini %6,4. En düşüğü, enflasyondan arındırılınca, %4,2. Bu, formülün hızının yarısından az olduğu için ikisinin ortası alındı: %9,9. Kaynakta temettü verimi yok; şirketin Haziran 2027 yılı (ilk temettü, tahmin) için açıkladığı hisse başına 26 JPY temettüden %1,9 hesaplandı.
basis.en: The formula gave growth of 15.6% a year. Latest figures (earnings per share, year on year): July-September 2026 quarter (first three months of the new fiscal year) 14.3%; July-September 2026 quarter 14.3%; company forecast for the year to June 2027 6.4%. The lowest, after inflation, is 4.2%. Because this is less than half the formula's rate, the midpoint of the two was used: 9.9%. The data source has no dividend yield; 1.9% was calculated from the dividend of 26 JPY per share the company declared for the year to June 2027 (first dividend, forecast).

8929.one: Varlıklı ailelere miras ve işletme devri danışmanlığı yapar. Kârı vergi kuralına ve büyük tekil işlere bağlı; hendek ölçütünü geçemedi.
8929.business: Aoyama Zaisan Networks, varlıklı kişilere ve şirket sahiplerine miras ve işletme devri danışmanlığı yapar. İki gelir kaynağı var. Birincisi danışmanlık ücretleri: 2026'nın ilk yarısında 5.761 milyon yen hasılat, 3.083 milyon yen brüt kâr. İkincisi gayrimenkul işlemleri: şirket bina alır, paylara böler ve 'ADVANTAGE CLUB' adıyla müşterilerine satar; ilk yarıda 6.958 milyon yen hasılat, 774 milyon yen brüt kâr. Mart 2026 sonunda 3.705 müşterisi vardı; müşteriler çoğunlukla banka ve muhasebe bürolarından yönlendirilir. 2025 yılı hasılatı 41.785 milyon yen, faaliyet kârı 3.858 milyon yen.
8929.moat_text: Hendek zayıf. Üstünlük güvene, uzun süren müşteri ilişkisine ve 200'den fazla yönlendiren ortağa dayanır; ADVANTAGE CLUB 2002'den beri 39 binada kullanıldı. Reel özsermaye kârlılığı son beş yılda %17,4 ile %23,1 arasında. Ama kârın önemli bir bölümü vergi kuralına bağlı bir üründen geliyordu: 2026 vergi düzenlemesi taslağı, paylara bölünmüş kiralık gayrimenkulün miras vergisi değerini 1 Ocak 2027'den sonra işlem fiyatına bağlıyor. Şirket, kuralın içeriği netleşene kadar satışın zayıf kaldığını yazdı: ADVANTAGE CLUB hasılatı 2026'nın ilk yarısında 16.131 milyon yenden 6.179 milyon yene düştü. Dokuz aylık net kâr %42,0 geriledi. Kâr ayrıca tek tek büyük işlere bağlı. Fiyatlama gücünü gösteren bir rakam (yıllara göre brüt marj, müşteri kaybı oranı) okunan belgelerde yok; bakıldı. B puanı bu yüzden 1.
8929.mgmt: Şirket kârın %50'sini dağıtmayı ilke edinmiş: 2025 için hisse başına 53 yen ödendi, 2026 beklentisi 58 yen (ara dönem 23, yıl sonu 35). Haziran 2026'da nakit 15.640 milyon yen, banka borcu 9.852 milyon yen (Aralık 2025: 6.142); özsermaye oranı %40,1. Borç artışı kısa vadeli krediden geliyor (100 milyon yenden 4.100 milyon yene). Şerefiye 1.099 milyon yen, ana ortaklık özsermayesinin (12.355 milyon yen) yaklaşık %9'u; vergi danışmanlığı şirketi Chester'ın alımından geliyor ve ana işle ilgilidir. Çalışanlara devri kısıtlı pay veriliyor: Haziran 2026'da 78.229 adet (payların yaklaşık %0,3'ü). Olağan dışı kalem yok denecek kadar az (1 milyon yen). Hâkim ortağa, geri alıma, garantilere ve emeklilik yükümlülüğüne bakıldı; okunan belgelerde yok.
8929.latest: 12 Kasım 2026: Şirket Ocak-Eylül 2026 dönemini açıkladı (rakamlar Kabutan haberinden; şirketin bülteni açılamadı). Dokuz aylık hasılat 16.713 milyon yen (−%51,0), faaliyet kârı 2.178 milyon yen (−%39,5), net kâr 1.419 milyon yen (−%42,0), hisse başına kâr 59,1 yen. Temmuz-Eylül çeyreğinde net kâr 280 milyon yen (−%76,1). Şirket yıl beklentisini değiştirmedi: faaliyet kârı 4.000 milyon yen, net kâr 2.650 milyon yen. Bunun tutması için son çeyrekte yaklaşık 1.231 milyon yen net kâr gerekir; geçen yılın aynı çeyreği 305 milyon yendi. Şirket ağustosta dokuz ayda faaliyet kârının yaklaşık %75'ine ulaşmayı bekliyordu; gerçekleşen %54.
risks: Kaynağın oran sayfası haziran sonunda kalmış ve F/K'yı 10,58 gösteriyor; eylül sonuçlarıyla son 12 ayın kârı düştü ve evrendeki 15,9 doğru rakamdır.
Vergi kuralı 2027'de taslaktaki gibi uygulanırsa ADVANTAGE CLUB'ın miras vergisi avantajı kalkar; bu ürünün satışı eski düzeyine dönmeyebilir.
Yıl beklentisi son çeyrekte tek tek büyük işlerin kapanmasına bağlı; dokuz ayda beklentinin ancak %54'üne ulaşıldı.
Gayrimenkul fiyatları ve faiz yükselirse hem bina alımı hem müşteri talebi etkilenir; kısa vadeli borç altı ayda 4.000 milyon yen arttı.

en.one: Advises wealthy families on inheritance and business succession. Profit depends on a tax rule and on large single deals; it did not pass the moat test.
en.business: Aoyama Zaisan Networks advises wealthy individuals and company owners on inheritance and business succession. It has two sources of revenue. The first is consulting fees: revenue of 5,761 million yen and gross profit of 3,083 million yen in the first half of 2026. The second is real estate transactions: the company buys buildings, splits them into shares and sells them to its clients under the name 'ADVANTAGE CLUB'; revenue of 6,958 million yen and gross profit of 774 million yen in the first half. It had 3,705 clients at the end of March 2026; clients are mostly referred by banks and accounting firms. Revenue in 2025 was 41,785 million yen and operating profit 3,858 million yen.
en.moat_text: The moat is weak. The advantage rests on trust, long client relationships and more than 200 referring partners; ADVANTAGE CLUB has been used for 39 buildings since 2002. Real return on equity was between 17.4% and 23.1% over the last five years. But an important part of profit came from a product tied to a tax rule: the FY2026 tax reform outline links the inheritance tax value of fractional rental property to the transaction price from 1 January 2027. The company wrote that sales stayed weak until the content of the rule became clear: ADVANTAGE CLUB revenue fell from 16,131 million yen to 6,179 million yen in the first half of 2026. Nine-month net profit fell 42.0%. Profit also depends on individual large deals. No figure that shows pricing power (gross margin by year, client loss rate) is in the documents read; we looked. This is why the B score is 1.
en.mgmt: The company's policy is to pay out 50% of profit: 53 yen a share was paid for 2025 and the 2026 forecast is 58 yen (interim 23, year-end 35). In June 2026 cash was 15,640 million yen and bank debt 9,852 million yen (December 2025: 6,142); the equity ratio was 40.1%. The rise in debt comes from short-term loans (from 100 million yen to 4,100 million yen). Goodwill is 1,099 million yen, about 9% of the parent's equity (12,355 million yen); it comes from the purchase of the tax advisory firm Chester and is related to the core business. Employees receive restricted shares: 78,229 in June 2026 (about 0.3% of the shares). Extraordinary items are negligible (1 million yen). We looked for a controlling shareholder, buybacks, guarantees and pension obligations; they are not in the documents read.
en.latest: 12 November 2026: The company reported January-September 2026 (figures from the Kabutan report; the company's release could not be opened). Nine-month revenue was 16,713 million yen (−51.0%), operating profit 2,178 million yen (−39.5%), net profit 1,419 million yen (−42.0%) and earnings per share 59.1 yen. In the July-September quarter net profit was 280 million yen (−76.1%). The company did not change its full-year forecast: operating profit 4,000 million yen, net profit 2,650 million yen. For this to hold, net profit of about 1,231 million yen is needed in the last quarter; it was 305 million yen in the same quarter last year. In August the company expected to reach about 75% of operating profit in nine months; the actual figure is 54%.
risks: The source's ratio page stops at the end of June and shows a P/E of 10.58; with the September results the profit of the last 12 months fell, and the universe figure of 15.9 is the right one.
If the tax rule applies in 2027 as in the outline, the inheritance tax advantage of ADVANTAGE CLUB disappears; sales of this product may not return to their old level.
The full-year forecast depends on individual large deals closing in the last quarter; only 54% of the forecast was reached in nine months.
If property prices and interest rates rise, both building purchases and client demand are affected; short-term debt rose by 4,000 million yen in six months.

verify.tr: Fark yeni çeyrekten geliyor; pay bölünmesi yok. Oran sayfası haziran 2026'da kalmış: F/K 10,58 = 1.162 yen ÷ yaklaşık 109 yen (2025 yılı 114,8 − 2025 ilk yarı 53,26 + 2026 ilk yarı 47,52). Evren eylül 2026 sonuçlarını (12 Kasım 2026) içeriyor: son dört çeyreğin hisse başına kârı 12,7 + 24,2 + 23,3 + 11,7 = 71,9 yen (Kabutan), 1.162 ÷ 71,9 = 16,2; evrendeki 15,9 buna %2 yakın. Düşüşün nedeni Temmuz-Eylül 2026 çeyreği: net kâr 280 milyon yen, bir yıl önce 1.170 milyon yen. Evrenin rakamı doğru; düzeltme gerekmiyor. PD/DD iki kaynakta aynı (2,29 ve 2,26).
verify.en: The gap comes from the new quarter; there is no stock split. The ratio page stops at June 2026: P/E 10.58 = 1,162 yen ÷ about 109 yen (FY2025 114.8 − first half of 2025 53.26 + first half of 2026 47.52). The universe includes the September 2026 results (12 November 2026): EPS of the last four quarters is 12.7 + 24.2 + 23.3 + 11.7 = 71.9 yen (Kabutan), and 1,162 ÷ 71.9 = 16.2; the universe figure of 15.9 is within 2% of that. The fall is due to the July-September 2026 quarter: net profit of 280 million yen against 1,170 million yen a year earlier. The universe figure is right; no fix is needed. P/B is the same in both sources (2.29 and 2.26).
